name: Escape Logs For Lucky Blocks
desc:
Welcome to Escape Logs for Lucky Blocks! 🪵🍀

Dash out and collect Lucky Blocks before the logs roll in! 🏃‍♂️
Dodge massive crashing logs and survive as long as you can! ⚠️
Build and upgrade your Brainrot setup to generate tons of cash! 💸
Expand your plot to unlock more space and place even more Brainrots! 🏗️

Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE while you’re away! 💤

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE cash + a Brainrot!
